Chapter 26

Chapter 26: Love at First Sight for the Beautiful Twin Girls!

After two consecutive goals, Song Yi, the tall and strong man, and the tanned man all looked anxious.

So, when the new game started, the three of them went straight to the basket.

They had to get a goal in the shortest time possible.

However…

Sometimes, things always went against one’s wishes.

Boom!

The basketball spun around the basket and rolled into it in the end.

The big, tanned guy’s expression changed slightly. He hurriedly jumped up, trying to grab the rebound.

However, his speed was already half a beat slower.

No. 3 grabbed the basketball and threw it to Lin Fan.

Lin Fan’s strength had won him recognition.

No. 3 wanted Lin Fan to lead the team and score another goal.

However, No. 3 seemed to be too excited and accidentally used too much force, causing the ball to deviate from its course.

Even Lin Fan could not catch the basketball immediately. He could only let it fly out of the court.

At that moment, girls in blue and red dresses walked over.

They saw that the basketball was about to hit them, but it was too late to dodge.

The two girls ‘pretty faces were slightly pale, and a thin layer of sweat seeped out.

At this moment, a tall figure suddenly appeared in front of them and caught the basketball firmly.

It was Lin Fan.

Lin Fan turned his head and said, “Are you guys okay?”

Bright and spirited eyes, a high nose bridge, and thin lips…

At this moment, the two girls seemed to see a peerless hero descending from the sky, and it was like he had rainbow clouds under his feet. They were completely dazed.

[Ding! Charm aura, love at first sight triggered!]

[Ding! Charm aura, love at first sight triggered!]

When Lin fan heard the notification in his mind, he was stunned.

He could not help but carefully size up the two girls in front of him.

Only then did he realize that apart from the color of their clothes, they looked almost exactly the same.

They had the same porcelain doll-like face, the same snow-white skin, and the same perfectly developed body!

They were actually twins!

Lin Fan could not help but use his Eyes of Truth to observe the two of them.

The girl in the blue dress.

[Face Value: 95]

[Favorability: 99]

The girl in the red dress.

[Face value: 95]

[Favorability: 99]

Both of them had a score of 95 points for their looks, and their favorability had reached 99 points!

One had to know that the full score for appearance and favorability was only 100 points!

They were definitely great beauties!

Moreover, they were twin beauties who loved him to death!

They had fallen for him just because he helped them block the basketball?

The beautiful twin girls saw that Lin Fan kept staring at them, and their faces turned red like ripe tomatoes.

“Lin Fan, are you alright?” Song Yi asked.

“I’m fine!” Lin Fan said.

“That’s good. Have some water first!” As Song Yi spoke, he threw the energy drink over.

Lin Fan was indeed feeling a little thirsty. He unscrewed the bottle and gulped down half a bottle.

Then, he threw the ball to Song Yi.

The street basketball match began again!

It was different from the previous game.

At this moment, a pair of beautiful twins appeared on the empty basketball court.

They stared at Lin Fan as he dribbled the ball, defended, and passed the ball.

After Lin Fan scored, their two hearts started to beat wildly.

Just as Lin Fan finished his last sip of the energy drink, the beautiful twins appeared in front of him, each holding a bottle of energy drink.

“Are they for me?” Lin Fan asked.

The beautiful twin girls nodded at the same time.

Lin Fan did not stand on ceremony. He took the energy drinks, opened one of the bottles, and took a sip.

A smile immediately appeared on the porcelain doll-like face of the beautiful woman in the blue dress, and a small canine tooth was vaguely visible in her cherry-like mouth.

The beautiful woman in the red dress had a pair of gem-like eyes that were filled with anticipation.

Lin Fan hesitated for a moment, then opened the second bottle of energy drink and took a sip.

Instantly, the beauty in the red dress also revealed a sweet smile.

In the distance, Song Yi looked at his empty bottle of energy drink and then at the two bottles in Lin Fan’s hands. He could not help but gulp.

The match continued.

Lin Fan had professional basketball skills, an extraordinary physique, and absolute focus. He also had an endless supply of energy drinks.

With so many advantages, how could he lose?

The street basketball game lasted for more than two hours.

In the end, Song Yi’s team lost.

Song Yi lay on the ground like a dead dog and said, “Lin Fan, are you sure you haven’t played basketball in a long time?”

“Yup,” Lin Fan replied casually.

When Song Yi heard this, a drop of hot sweat fell into his eyes.

Instantly, turbid tears rolled down from the corner of his eyes.

Lin Fan did not care much. He walked to the beautiful twins and said, “Thank you for the energy drinks.”

The beautiful twin girls shook their heads together, indicating that he was welcome.

Then, they took out their phones at the same time and looked at Lin Fan with anticipation.

“Do you want to add me on WeChat?” Lin Fan asked.

The beautiful twins nodded in unison.

“Alright,” Lin Fan replied.

As he spoke, he opened the WeChat friend request interface.

Seeing this, the beautiful twin’s gem-like eyes faintly bloomed with stars, and they hurriedly added him as a friend.

Then, the two of them held their phone tightly in their arms as if they were holding a precious treasure and were afraid of losing it.

“I’m going back to my dormitory. You guys should go back early too. It’s pretty hot outside,” Lin Fan said.

The beautiful twin girls nodded their heads repeatedly.

…

In the dormitory.

After they returned, Zheng Jinbao looked at Lin Fan and Song Yi, who were covered in sweat. He smiled and asked, “Lin Fan, you haven’t played basketball for a long time. How was it? You were abused badly this time, weren’t you?”

“Don’t say those words again!” Song Yi shouted.

When he heard these words, he felt his heart being stabbed.

“You don’t know this, but as long as Lin Fan gets the ball, he’ll be able to shoot it accurately! We played for more than two hours and my team only got two goals. Our team only scored two goals!”

Song Yi’s movements were too big as he spoke. A drop of sweat on his forehead rolled into his eyes.

Instantly, hot tears rolled down his face.

Zheng Jinbao laughed and said, “Didn’t you just play basketball? Why are you crying now?”

“I’m not crying cry!” Song Yi retorted.

However, the tears in his eyes fell again.

Zheng Jinbao looked at his comical appearance and laughed even louder.

Song Yi felt wronged and said, “Why do I play basketball? It’s just to attract girls!

“I play basketball in school almost every day, but none of the girls have ever asked me for my WeChat!

“At the end, when Lin Fan played basketball in school for the first time, a pair of twins actually took the initiative to buy drinks for him and ask for his WeChat!”

As soon as he said this, Zheng Jinbao’s smile stopped as he hurriedly asked, “What? Twins? Are they pretty?”

Fat otakus had no way to resist twins.

Song Yi said, “Perfect figures and baby faces. You tell me if they’re pretty!”

“Heavens!”

Zheng Jinbao shouted to the sky, and the fat on his whole body trembled.

He clutched his chest as if he had been stabbed.
